documents.population: First-year international applicants (students who require an F-1 visa) to UCLA, including Computer Science (Samueli School of Engineering)
documents.notes: UCLA Undergraduate Admission 'International Applicants' and 'First-Year Requirements' pages. Standing pages; no year is printed on the list (the financial example names 'students admitted to Fall Quarter 2026'). FAQ: 'We do not require or accept letters of recommendation in our process and we do not collect transcripts at the point of application'; 'UCLA does not consider SAT or ACT scores for admission or scholarship purposes.' External exam results are self-reported in the UC Application ('International External Exams'). Documents of all college or university coursework must be sent in the original language with English translations, after admission (not drafted: it concerns college coursework). Admitted students whose native language is not English may have to take UCLA's ESL Placement Examination. Not drafted: medical insurance (after admission). Some majors in the specialty schools need a supplemental application; none is named for Computer Science.

items.quote: In addition to your UC application, we take both your academic record and your personal experiences into consideration during the review process.
Personal Insight Questions These personal questions are just that — personal.
items.notes: 'As a first-year applicant, you may respond to four of eight questions. Each response is limited to a maximum of 350 words.'

items.quote: To demonstrate English language proficiency, students are required to take the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), the International English Language Testing Service (IELTS), or the Duolingo English Test.
items.condition: all or some high school or secondary school completed in a country where English was not the language of instruction, with less than 3 years of instruction in English; scores are self-reported on the UC application (no later than January)

items.quote: We require records from the secondary schools you have attended that show subjects taken and grades received, as well as any national or government certificates earned.
items.condition: if admitted: 'Please do not send these documents now. If you apply and are admitted, your admission packet will have instructions.'

items.quote: International students must prove that they have sufficient funds available to them to pay for their educational and living expenses.
